template<class T, class... Args> constexpr T& emplace(Args&&... args);
1
#
Constraints: is_constructible_v<T, Args...> is true, and

return emplace<I>(std::forward<Args>(args)...);

  constexpr T& emplace(initializer_list<U> il, Args&&... args);
